description: Added from Rust when the app starts (windows.rs), not listed in tauri.conf.json, whose release build enables only `default`. What the progress windows (M5.5, one per download) may do: Zajil's own commands and events, set their own title (the percentage and the file's name) and size (with or without the details), and the system's yes-or-no question before a file that can run code opens. Nothing else: no file system, no shell, no network from the page.
